_doc: UI a11y contract manifest (Cycle-3 Wave 5). THREE born-empty registries the uiA11yContract walker enforces over src/components: (1) zLayers — the frozen stacking manifest (every zIndex literal must resolve to a named layer or the local band); (2) mousedownActivationAllow — files exempt from the keyboard-reachable ban on mouse-only ACTIVATION; (3) handRolledTrapAllow — files exempt from the single-writer focus-trap rule. Edit this file only to REGISTER a new layer (with review) or, deliberately, to grandfather an exception. Do not raise the local ceiling to smuggle a global layer.
